title: Design System: recompiler.dll — Black Calibration Bench

module-title.purpose: Uppercase 28px module headers and the primary rack hierarchy.

control.purpose: Buttons, tabs, and direct operational actions.

data.purpose: Values, filenames, selects, and compact technical labels.

micro-data.purpose: Scales, axis labels, meter ticks, and subordinate telemetry.

shadows.name: selected-row-inset
shadows.purpose: Marks the selected sample without lifting the row.

shadows.name: primary-knob-rings
shadows.purpose: Hard concentric calibration rings around primary 66px macro knobs.

shadows.name: source-gain-ring
shadows.purpose: Subordinate calibration ring around the 38px source gain knob.

shadows.name: fader-cap-groove
shadows.purpose: Engraved hard line across the output fader cap.

motion.name: signal-telemetry
motion.purpose: Waveform-adjacent effect traces and stereo meters move only from real bounded audio telemetry.

motion.name: pressed-step
motion.purpose: Immediate mechanical displacement while a button is active; no easing.

motion.name: state-inversion
motion.purpose: Hover, selected, and active colors switch immediately with no transition.

components.name: Pixel Button
components.description: The canonical square action used for navigation, mode switching, and local commands.
components.css: .ds-pixel-button { min-height:28px; padding:2px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); border-radius:0; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); background:var(--surface, #111210); font:700 13px/1 var(--display-font, 'Pixelify Local', sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-pixel-button:hover, .ds-pixel-button[aria-pressed='true'] { color:var(--black, #090a09); background:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); } .ds-pixel-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-pixel-button:focus-visible { outline:1px dashed var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); outline-offset:-4px; }

components.name: Two-State Toggle
components.description: A joined binary switch whose selected half uses hard ivory inversion.
components.css: .ds-toggle { min-width:128px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } .ds-toggle-button { min-height:28px; padding:1px 8px; border:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); border-left:0; border-radius:0; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); background:var(--surface, #111210); font:700 13px/1 var(--display-font, 'Pixelify Local', sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-toggle-button:first-child { border-left:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); } .ds-toggle-button:hover, .ds-toggle-button.is-active { color:var(--black, #090a09); background:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); } .ds-toggle-button:focus-visible { outline:1px dashed var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); outline-offset:-4px; }

components.name: Calibration Select
components.description: A square black choice field for source and global settings.
components.css: .ds-select-label { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); font:700 11px/1 var(--display-font, 'Pixelify Local', sans-serif); } .ds-select { width:160px; height:32px; padding:1px 22px 1px 7px; border:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); border-radius:0; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); background:var(--black, #090a09); font:700 10px/1 var(--mono-font, 'Space Mono Local', monospace); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline:1px dashed var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); outline-offset:-4px; }

components.name: Voice Counter
components.description: A compact tabular telemetry badge in the header.
components.css: .ds-voice-counter { height:30px; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); border-radius:0; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); background:var(--black, #090a09); font:700 12px/1 var(--mono-font, 'Space Mono Local', monospace); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Instrument Panel
components.description: The square module container with a 28px equipment header and etched hatch.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); border-radius:0; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); background:var(--surface, #111210); } .ds-module-header { height:28px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:1px 7px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); font:700 17px/1 var(--display-font, 'Pixelify Local', sans-serif); letter-spacing:.01em; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-hatch { flex:1; height:9px; opacity:.7; background:repeating-linear-gradient(112deg, transparent 0 3px, var(--muted, #96958d) 3px 4px); } .ds-panel-body { min-height:72px; padding:6px; color:var(--muted, #96958d); background:var(--surface, #111210); font:700 10px/1 var(--mono-font, 'Space Mono Local', monospace); }

components.name: Primary Macro Knob
components.description: A 66px rotary macro with ivory ring, dashed calibration orbit, and hard pointer.
components.css: .ds-knob { --ds-angle:-22deg; position:relative; width:66px; height:66px; border:9px solid var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface, #111210); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--black, #090a09), 0 0 0 2px var(--muted, #96958d); } .ds-knob::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-13px; border:1px dashed var(--muted, #96958d); border-radius:50%; } .ds-knob:hover, .ds-knob:focus-visible { background:var(--control, #242520); outline:none; } .ds-knob i { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:3px; height:25px; transform-origin:50% 0; transform:rotate(var(--ds-angle)) translateY(-1px); background:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); }

components.name: Signal Display Chamber
components.description: A black, gridded instrument field for waveform, spectral, effect, or meter telemetry.
components.css: .ds-display { position:relative; width:220px; height:96px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--dim, #5e605a); border-radius:0; background-color:var(--black, #090a09); background-image:linear-gradient(to right, transparent 49.6%, var(--graticule, #3e413a) 50%, transparent 50.4%), linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 49.3%, var(--graticule, #3e413a) 50%, transparent 50.7%); background-size:12.5% 100%, 100% 33.333%; } .ds-trace { position:absolute; left:6px; right:6px; top:47px; height:2px; background:var(--telemetry, #eeede5); box-shadow:14px -8px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5), 28px 5px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5), 42px -14px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5), 56px 10px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5), 70px -4px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5), 84px 7px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5), 98px -11px 0 var(--telemetry, #eeede5); } .ds-display:focus-visible { outline:1px dashed var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Sample Row
components.description: A 30px source entry with square enable state, ellipsized filename, and compact action.
components.html: vox_chop_b2.aiff
components.css: .ds-sample-row { height:30px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:22px minmax(0, 1fr) 57px; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:2px; border-bottom:1px solid #33352f; color:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); background:var(--surface, #111210); font:400 10px/1 var(--mono-font, 'Space Mono Local', monospace); } .ds-sample-row:hover, .ds-sample-row.is-selected { background:var(--raised, #191a17); } .ds-sample-row.is-selected { box-shadow:inset 2px 0 var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); } .ds-sample-row > span { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-check, .ds-row-action { border:1px solid var(--line, #d7d3c8); border-radius:0; color:var(--black, #090a09); background:var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); font:700 10px/1 var(--display-font, 'Pixelify Local', sans-serif); } .ds-check { width:20px; height:20px; padding:0; } .ds-row-action { min-height:21px; padding:1px 4px; } .ds-check:focus-visible, .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline:1px dashed var(--ivory, #e8e4d8); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a compact operating surface, not a branded landing page: a near-black machined panel whose hierarchy comes from exact partitions, warm ivory calibration marks, and instrument-like readouts. Display chambers are the dominant black masses. Their waveform, particle, spectral, and meter graphics carry the visual energy while the surrounding hardware stays quiet, dense, and mechanically legible.

The interface preserves the approved fixed 960×647 logical geometry and treats every line as functional construction. Type is deliberately split between a pixel-built display face and a tabular data face. The left side of the header is an intentionally empty, unbranded equipment bay; its restraint is part of the identity, not missing content.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed 960×647 logical instrument canvas with whole-UI scale presets only.
Near-black tiered surfaces with warm ivory labels, rules, and state inversion.
Dense 4px top-level rhythm and one-pixel construction lines.
Square controls and containers; circles belong only to rotary controls.
Black display chambers with etched graticules and crisp, pixel-rendered telemetry.
Motion is evidence of audio activity, never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Ivory Inversion Rule
rules.body: Interactive selection and active states invert hard to warm ivory with bench-black text; do not introduce colored accents or soft tinted states.

rules.name: The Two Whites Rule
rules.body: Warm ivory belongs to the panel hardware; telemetry white belongs to live signal pixels inside display chambers.

rules.name: The Face Split Rule
rules.body: Pixelify Sans names and commands; Space Mono measures and reports. Do not swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Uppercase Panel Rule
rules.body: Operational labels are terse uppercase equipment markings, not sentence-case application copy.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: Scale the complete 960×647 bench; never rearrange, wrap, collapse, or independently resize its modules.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Top-level separation is 4px. Use smaller values only for internal optical fitting, not to create a competing spacing system.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use rules, tonal nesting, and calibration rings for depth; never add blur, glass, glow, or floating-card shadows.

rules.name: The Square Hardware Rule
rules.body: A zero-radius rectangle is the default silhouette. Radius is not a softness control; it is reserved for rotary mechanics.

dos: Do preserve the 960×647 logical canvas and the 75/100/125/150 whole-interface scale presets.
Do keep top-level gaps at 4px, module headers at 28px, and sample rows at 30px.
Do reserve the header’s left equipment bay as intentionally empty and unbranded.
Do use hard black/ivory inversion for active, selected, and hover states.
Do render waveform and telemetry canvases with image smoothing disabled.
Do let real signal telemetry be the only continuous motion on the surface.
donts: Don't add responsive reflow, breakpoint-specific rearrangement, or fluid typography.
Don't introduce accent hues, gradients outside the recessed equipment bay, or more white variants.
Don't round panels, buttons, fields, rows, readouts, or display chambers.
Don't add ambient animation, decorative pulses, loading shimmer, or easing to audio controls.
Don't add a wordmark, subtitle, icon, or placeholder copy to the empty header bay.
Don't soften construction with blurred shadows, glass effects, glow, or anti-aliased canvas graphics.
